SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

223
11 - 3 - 43

Foreign Affairs Section Station XXXX File No.................... Date.................... 24-2-43

SUBJECT: Change of status of Mr.E.A.David.

Mr.E.A.David, presently residing at 565 Wayside
Rd, arrived in Shanghai, accompanied by his parents Mr.A.
and Mrs H.David, from Europe in May, 1939. They were all
considered to be German Jewish refugees.

Mr.A.David, head of the family, died on the 3-
2-40.

Being of Aryan blood Mrs H.David, widow, applied
to the German Consulate and had her expired passport re-
newed, whilst her son's document was not prolonged owing
to his Aryan-Jewish descent.

In Sept. 1942, when filling in the Pao Chia cen-
sus forms, Mrs David described herself and her son as Ger-
man. However, only she was issued with an Axis resident
certificate whilst her son's document was stamped with a
"J".

On the 20-2-43 E.A.David proceeded to the German
Consulate where he applied for the prolongation of his
passport, which was refused. The Consular Authorities,
however, stamped the Pao Chia census form, which was in
his possession, to the effect that "persons mentioned on
the list are German nationals".

On the strength of this, the Yulin Rd St. Pao
Chia Office issued E.A.David with an Axis resident certi-
ficate.

O. [Signature]
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs
C. & S. Branch

（批：10 3 43 [Signature]）

223
1943年3月11日

外事科 第XXXX巡捕房 档案号.................... 日期.................... 1943年2月24日

事由：E.A. David先生身份变更。

E.A. David先生，现居住于威赛德路（Wayside Rd）565号，于1939年5月在其父母A. David先生和H. David夫人的陪同下从欧洲抵达上海。他们均被视为德籍犹太难民。

家长A. David先生于1940年2月3日去世。

H. David夫人作为寡妇，因具有雅利安血统，向德国领事馆申请并更新了其过期的护照，而其子的证件因其雅利安-犹太混血血统未获延期。

1942年9月，在填写保甲户口调查表时，David夫人将其本人及其子描述为德国人。然而，仅她本人获发了轴心国居民证，而其子的证件上盖有“J”字样印章。

1943年2月20日，E.A. David前往德国领事馆申请延长其护照，但被拒绝。不过，领事当局在他持有的保甲户口调查表上盖章，注明“名单所列人员为德国国民”。

凭此证明，榆林路巡捕房保甲办事处向E.A. David签发了轴心国居民证。

O. [签名]
副督察长

外事主管警官
刑事与特别科

（批注：1943年3月10日 [签名]）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（批：228 10-3-43）

Yulin Road Station. File No. Date March 8, 1943.

SUBJECT: Change of status of Mr. E. A. David.

Sir,

I beg to report that Mr. E. A. David, residing at
565 Wayside Road, called at the Foreign Pao Chia Office
Yulin Road to-day, and, according to instruction
received on 26-2-43, the Axis-residents Certificate,
which was issued to him on 20-2-43, was cancelled, and
a new certificate, stamped with a "J" was made out in
his name.

（批：File 9/3/43）

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
エル・シモン
F. P. S. 7.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
Crime & Special Branch.

（印：□□□□）
（批：DATE 10/3/43）

报告
（批注：228 1943年3月10日）

榆林路巡捕房。 档案号。 日期：1943年3月8日。

事由：E. A. David先生身份变更。

敬启者，

谨此报告，居住于威赛德路（Wayside Road）565号的E. A. David先生今日来到榆林路外侨保甲办事处，根据1943年2月26日收到的指示，取消了他于1943年2月20日获发的轴心国居民证，并以他的名义重新签发了一份盖有“J”字样印章的新证书。

（批注：归档 1943年3月9日）

此致
敬礼
エル・シモン
F. P. S. 7.

外事主管警官，
刑事与特别科。

（印章：□□□□）
（批注：日期 1943年3月10日）
